paragraph: Ridgefield's single-family market is the core here, with 23 sales over six months at a median of $720,000 and a sale-to-list ratio of exactly 1.00. Slightly under half sold above asking with a median of 26 days on market, which is competitive but not frenzied. Priced homes are moving, and sellers who stretch are waiting. The range runs from $520,000 to $1,375,000, so the median is the better guide than either end. Multi-family is the tighter category, 8 sales at a median of $920,000, a 1.03 sale-to-list ratio, 75 percent above asking, and a median of 14.5 days on market. Those are seller's market numbers, though eight sales is a small sample and Ridgefield's two-family stock draws both owner-occupants and investors bidding on the same houses. Condos and townhouses are thin at 6 sales with a median of $322,500, nothing above asking, and a range from $225,000 to $935,000 that tells you this category holds very different products. On the monthly numbers, most months carry fewer than five closings, so there is no readable monthly trend. The six-month picture is the honest read, and if Ridgefield follows the usual Bergen seasonal arc, expect fall closings to soften from summer levels.
